{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by keeping the row with the highest `sample_seq` for each `patient_id`
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Confirm no duplicates remain
print("After deduplication, duplicate patient_id:", df_dedup['patient_id'].duplicated().any())

# Check the shape after deduplication
print("Shape after deduplication:", df_dedup.shape)

# Re-check the distribution of `arm`
print("\nDistribution of `arm` after deduplication:")
print(df_dedup['arm'].value_counts())

# Re-check the distribution of `severity`
print("\nDistribution of `severity` after deduplication:")
print(df_dedup['severity'].value_counts())

# Re-check the mean biomarker_baseline by arm
print("\nMean biomarker_baseline by arm after deduplication:")
print(df_dedup.groupby('arm')['biomarker_baseline'].mean())

# Re-check the mean biomarker_final by arm
print("\nMean biomarker_final by arm after deduplication:")
print(df_dedup.groupby('arm')['biomarker_final'].mean())"}
